title: Continuum architecture is staged
claim: The repository contains a versioned charter, data contracts, dashboard, and scheduled pulse path.
falsifier: A validation run or deployment check shows that one of the declared components is absent or unusable.

title: Heartbeat and world refresh are separate states
claim: The daily workflow can report scheduler health without claiming that live world evidence was collected.
falsifier: The dashboard labels a heartbeat-only run as fresh world intelligence.

title: Protected reconnaissance is local-only
claim: The first workspace inventory records metadata privately and does not publish project names or alter existing work.
falsifier: A private inventory file appears in the public repository or the reconnaissance pass modifies an existing project.

title: AI collection is browser-first
claim: PAM Continuum routes AI collection through visible browser or desktop-app sessions and does not use AI APIs for collection.
falsifier: An AI collection run uses an API client or silently substitutes an API path for a visible UI session.
